_comment: Generated by tools/data_gen/build_vanity_stalls.py. The `rebut` choice is gated on a flag set by an EARLIER chapter, so answering the fair requires having learned something on the way to it.

start.speaker: The Mirror-Seller
start.text: Every mirror on the road has shown you what you lack. This one shows you what you are worth. Would you not rather see that?
start.text_zh: 这一路上的镜子，照的都是你缺的东西。这一面照的是你值多少。你不想看看吗？

text_variants.text: Every mirror on the road has shown you what you lack. This one shows you what you are worth. Would you not rather see that?
text_variants.text_zh: 您早该有一面配得上您的镜子了。

text_variants.text: Every mirror on the road has shown you what you lack. This one shows you what you are worth. Would you not rather see that?
text_variants.text_zh: 你的眼太清了，不好做生意。不过——这一路上的镜子，照的都是你缺的东西。这一面照的是你值多少。你不想看看吗？

choices.text: I have already stood in front of something that told me what I was worth. It was lying too.
choices.text_zh: 我已经站在一个告诉我「我值多少」的东西面前了。它也在撒谎。

choices.text: Buy it. Surely one small indulgence won't cost me much.
choices.text_zh: 买下吧。区区一点放纵，想必花不了我多少。

choices.text: No. My peace is not for sale at this fair.
choices.text_zh: 不。我的平安不在这集市上出售。

answered.speaker: The Mirror-Seller
answered.text_zh: 镜面里映出你的脸，然后是贩子的。他把镜子转了过去。

bought.speaker: The Mirror-Seller
bought.text: A wise purchase! Wear it well... it suits the crowd, if not the road.
bought.text_zh: 明智之选！好好戴着……它配得上人群，纵然配不上这条路。

refused.speaker: The Mirror-Seller
refused.text: Suit yourself. The narrow-eyed never could enjoy a good fair.
refused.text_zh: 随你便。眯着眼的人，从来就享受不了一场好集市。
